messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Um,{01 00 00 0a 00} you're good at
catching bugs,{01 00 00 05 00} right,
{04 1f 00}?
Yeah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}Then,{01 00 00 05 00} should we
compete to see who can
catch the rarest insect?
{07 0d 00}We'll find a bug that gets
shy when it sees someone it
doesn't know, {01 00 00 0a 00}kinda like me.
{07 00 00}As for whose bug is shyest,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 11 00}since I'm the expert, I
guess I'll be the judge.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ee,{01 00 00 0a 00} sa oled putukate
püüdmises hea,{01 00 00 05 00} eks,
{04 1f 00}?
Jah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}Siis,{01 00 00 05 00} kas võistleme,
kes püüab kõige
haruldasema putuka?
{07 0d 00}Otsime putukat, kes muutub
häbelikuks võõra nähes,
{01 00 00 0a 00}umbes nagu mina.
{07 00 00}Kelle putukas on häbelikum,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 11 00}selle otsustan mina, kuna
olen asjatundja.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}OK, {04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}I know you
and the insects are all
buddy-buddy,{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 0b 00}So how about for our next
competition, we look for
the king of all bugs?
{07 00 00}We have to look for rare
bugs.{01 00 00 05 00} The kind you hardly
ever see.
{07 0d 00}The person who nabs the
shyest bug wins,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Olgu, {04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}ma tean, et
sina ja putukad olete
suured sõbrad,{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 0b 00}Aga mis siis, kui otsime
järgmises võistluses
kõigi putukate kuningat?
{07 00 00}Peame otsima haruldasi
putukaid.{01 00 00 05 00} Selliseid, keda
vaevalt kunagi näed.
{07 0d 00}Võidab see, kes napsab
kõige häbelikuma putuka,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
